faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What services does Kashmir Digital offer?
faq.a1: We offer a complete range of digital services: premium websites, AI agents, intelligent automations, high-conversion content for ads, copywriting, SEO, Voice AI & Audio Branding, and much more.
faq.q2: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a2: It depends on complexity. A premium landing page can be ready in 1-2 weeks. A complete project with AI agents can take 3-6 weeks.
faq.q3: What are voice agents and how do they work?
faq.a3: They are AI agents that talk on the phone just like a real person. They can take your calls, schedule appointments, sell products or provide support — 24/7.
faq.q4: Does Kashmir Digital work with international clients?
faq.a4: Absolutely. You can work with us from anywhere — video call, WhatsApp, email.
faq.q5: Does Kashmir Digital offer maintenance after delivery?
faq.a5: Yes, you get continuous maintenance — updates, performance optimizations, monitoring, and technical support.
